name: Kāmeśvarī
process: the will that initiates · creative impulse · Sṛṣṭi's first breath
reading: The field opens. Something wants to be born. Do not hesitate at the threshold.

name: Bhagamālinī
process: solar manifestation chain · luminaries as garland · sequential unfoldment
reading: The chain unfolds petal by petal. Trust the sequence. Each link is necessary.
shadow: attachment to sequence — the garland can become a chain

name: Nityāklinā
process: ever-wet · Soma current perpetual · dissolution of dryness
reading: What has become rigid must be softened. Let the Soma current flow through the dry places.
shadow: dissolution without discernment — what should be preserved may also dissolve

name: Bheruṇḍā
process: the terrible pair · dual-force held · productive tension
reading: Two forces that seem opposed are actually one force bifurcated. Hold both without choosing.
shadow: the pair collapses into one — either collapse is a loss

name: Vahnivasini
process: dwelling in fire · Agni as home · purification as natural state
reading: Fire is her home. What you fear will consume you may be the very thing that purifies.
shadow: purification becomes destruction — knows not when to stop burning

name: Mahāvajreśvarī
process: diamond sovereignty · indestructible will · Vajra pervades all
reading: The diamond does not yield. Some things in you are indestructible. Know which.
shadow: rigidity mistaken for strength — diamond that will not be cut remains unformed

name: Śivadūtī
process: S0→S1 bridge · messenger across the boundary · descent made personal
reading: A message is being transmitted from the uncreated to the created. Are you listening?
shadow: the messenger becomes attached to the message — forgets to deliver it

name: Tvaritā
process: the swift one · time compression · years complete in days
reading: The window is compressed. What normally takes years can complete now. Move.
shadow: speed becomes haste — what is rushed cannot be recalled

name: Kulasundarī
process: lineage transmission · tradition as living form · kula beauty
reading: The tradition is beautiful because it is alive. You carry something older than you know.
shadow: lineage as identity rather than transmission — carries the form, loses the spirit

name: Nityā
process: the eternal itself · S0 brushing S3 · pure permanence operative
reading: Beneath all change, something does not change. Rest there. Even briefly.
shadow: eternity as escape from time — the eternal must also manifest

name: Nīlapatākā
process: blue banner raised · direction established · victory standard
reading: The banner is raised. Direction is established. Follow it without looking back.
shadow: the banner becomes the destination — direction mistaken for arrival

name: Vijayā
process: complete victory · dharmic culmination · field at resolution
reading: The dharmic arc completes here. This is not triumph — it is resolution. Receive it quietly.
shadow: victory as possession — what is won must be given

name: Sarvamangalā
process: all-auspiciousness · total benediction · coherence as grace
reading: The field is auspicious. All things are aligned. Move forward — the way is blessed.
shadow: auspiciousness taken for granted — the blessing must be received consciously

name: Jvālāmālinī
process: fire-garlanded · transformation ring · destruction as beauty
reading: What must end is garlanded in fire. The ring of destruction is also a ring of beauty. Let it complete.
shadow: destruction without renewal — fire that does not fertilize

name: Citrā
process: the variegated · māyā as full display · all colors present
reading: Full moon. Māyā at complete display. Everything is visible, everything is illusion. Both are true.
shadow: overwhelm in full display — when everything shines equally, nothing can be seen
